claims.text: The platform lets you set your brand voice once and generate a week of on-brand posts from a single goal for approval.
The platform offers a 14-day free trial with no card required.

disclosure: Response-time benchmark reflects widely-cited industry lead response research (e.g., Lead Response Management studies); presented as a general pattern, not a Black Arrow-generated metric.

claims.text: The Revenue Calculator is a free tool on blackarrow.ltd/tools that uses four inputs (monthly leads, close rate, average job value, response time) to model revenue per lead and a follow-up gap.
Only about 17% of service businesses answer a lead within an hour, and answering within 5 minutes roughly doubles the close rate.
